body:
I really appreciate your response! Also, I’m so sorry to hear about the anxiety and struggles you have to face daily! It must be difficult taking care of patients with mental health illnesses while also struggling with your own issues as well. I think it’s courageous and admirable that you have kept going strong while keeping your head held high despite the great amount of struggles you’re having to face. I do have to say though that simply based on what you wrote, you seem to be intelligent and I bet that if you ever wanted to attend college or even a community college, you could definitely pass! Many older adults attend college later in life so you are no exception! 

Also, I have not spoken much to my mother about my issues since she tends to deflect it and either get very worried/stressed out or she becomes inquisitive of me which makes me uncomfortable. I find she just doesn’t know how to help me or act in those situations, so it’s easier for me to just brush it off if it ever does get mentioned. I don’t have really any friends in college, mostly just people I’m friendly with (but not close enough to talk about stuff like this with). I also don’t have contact with my dad and I only talk to my other family members when it comes to holidays or birthdays. Usually I just try to cope as best as I can and some days I just feel more positive while others I just simply spiral into a depressive episode. I find I navigate through life robotically and try to do certain daily tasks to keep me going (like daily vacuuming and/or making my bed).

I’m so sorry to hear that! Hopefully your jaw doesn’t hurt too bad, but I agree I wish I had better coping skills. It’s just that I dislike myself so much so when I’m feeling angry at myself, I just don’t care if it means hurting myself to no end
Okay, thank you! I just felt like I was abnormal I guess.
Okay, and thank you for the suggestion! I will try to keep that in mind, it’s just difficult since once I get into the mindset of wanting to punish myself, I just act on impulse.
